source_review: Mask is pooled-reference only: passed proximity, three inequalities per passed orientation record, two guidance inequalities per eligible orientation record.
All offsets are zero. Existing 1nm and 1e-8 inward search buffers remain on every row. A buffered-infeasible reference is refused, not silently exempted.
Epigraph slack coefficient and its analytic Jacobian column are zero on hard rows and one on remaining rows. Joint derivatives are unchanged.
Solver uses one fixed pooled start,25 iterations,1000 raw/30 exact maximum,2 reserved terminal checks and180s cooperative search stop.

All original exact caps, mean, physical/search domain, full eligibility and passed-row preservation remain acceptance gates. Raw probes cannot be selected. Fresh selected check and pooled fallback retain exact predicate checks.
Driver uses the reviewed frozen pose-module overlay and does not load the concurrently edited live pose module.

Far guidance stays unclamped; for positive bands the feasible set matches literal far classification. Nonsmooth facet/tie/burial/membership constraints remain covered by exact gates, not fully by raw inequalities.

scope: Pre-execution implementation review only; not a mapping validity result or global feasibility claim. Root must freeze final protocol/source bindings before fitting.
